message: FD BATCH-CONTROL-FILE (line 33) and FD PROCESS-SEQ-FILE (line 36) have no inline 01 record; their record descriptions come from COPY BCHCTL (line 34) and COPY PRCSEQ (line 37). The copybook records are linked by EXPANDS_COPY from the FILE section (SYS-PORTFOLIO-001-FIL-0047-SEC-0003); no FILE records are registered for this program, so the copybook records carry no fd_name. PRCSEQ supplies two 01 records (PROCESS-SEQUENCE-RECORD, STANDARD-SEQUENCES) to FD PROCESS-SEQ-FILE.
